scope: SolarWinds and separately labelled StellarParticle follow-on reporting; not a single reconstructed intrusion

techniques.name: Compromise Software Supply Chain
techniques.reported_behavior: Trojanized Orion software updates delivered SUNBURST.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Correlate software inventory, update provenance and unusual child processes.

techniques.name: PowerShell
techniques.reported_behavior: PowerShell supported post-compromise commands and task operations.
techniques.project_application: Weeks 5-7 contain the historical Windows PowerShell observations.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Retain command lines, script-block logs when enabled and process ancestry.

techniques.name: Windows Command Shell
techniques.reported_behavior: cmd.exe executed commands on remote machines.
techniques.project_application: Historical cmd control is not validation of remote execution.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Join remote authentication to process creation; distinguish administrative jobs.

techniques.name: Scheduled Task
techniques.reported_behavior: Existing scheduled tasks were temporarily modified, then restored.
techniques.project_application: Week 8 planned persistence; not executed in Week 9.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Compare task definitions over time and correlate registration with payload execution.

techniques.name: Credentials from Web Browsers
techniques.reported_behavior: RDP Bitmap Cache reconstruction showed a Chrome export of saved passwords to plaintext CSV (CrowdStrike figure 4).
techniques.project_application: Mock JSON is not a browser credential store or DPAPI validation.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Monitor unusual access/export involving browser credential stores with suitable EDR telemetry.

techniques.name: Steal Web Session Cookie
techniques.reported_behavior: Shellbags showed Chrome and DPAPI directory navigation. Falcon identified the Cookie Editor extension used in the reported session reuse (figures 2–3).
techniques.project_application: Fake cookies were archived; no valid session or cookie theft was tested.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Correlate sensitive browser-file access with identity and session anomalies.

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.reported_behavior: Volexity recorded a 7-Zip command naming the exported local file C:\Temp\b.pst as its input on the OWA server.
techniques.project_application: The lab has synthetic file opens and archive member checks. The reported Exchange collection is CTI only.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Correlate the PST export and a subsequent ReadData event for the PST with the 7-Zip process, then look separately for staging and a web request.

techniques.name: Archive via Utility
techniques.reported_behavior: 7-Zip created password-protected archives, sometimes split into parts.
techniques.project_application: Week 9 exercised Linux tar/gzip and Windows tar.exe on synthetic files.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Review archiver command lines and source paths; correlate outputs and later egress.

techniques.name: Remote Data Staging
techniques.reported_behavior: Archives were staged on a victim OWA server.
techniques.project_application: Local out/ artifacts do not demonstrate remote staging.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Join remote file writes, server role and authentication context.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Asymmetric Encrypted Non-C2 Protocol
techniques.reported_behavior: MITRE C0024 maps retrieval of a staged OWA archive over HTTPS to T1048.002. Volexity shows the 7-Zip command that created Redir.png and gives an illustrative HTTPS URL.
techniques.project_application: The lab collected local archive telemetry. Volexity publishes no request log for the illustrated URL.
techniques.proposed_hunt: Check IIS or reverse-proxy logs for the staged URI, request time, response status and bytes served. Correlate them with creation time and archive size.
